_comment: Canary through the runtime itself: detects a runtime whose MCP session is stuck, which --healthcheck (a fresh process) cannot see. Pair it with a dead-man's switch that alerts when HEALTH_OK does not arrive.
name: crm-mcp-canary
prompt: Call the crm_salud tool exactly once. If it returns 'CRM health: OK', reply with exactly HEALTH_OK. If the tool is unavailable or returns an error, reply with HEALTH_FAIL followed by the error text. Do nothing else.
